name: io.github.DasDigitaleMomentum/searxncrawl
title: searxNcrawl
description: Web search via SearXNG and/or You.com, plus clean Markdown crawling via Crawl4AI. Self-hosted.

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_URL
environmentVariables.description: URL of your SearXNG instance with JSON output enabled; enables SearXNG search (no default)

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Optional basic auth user for SearXNG (set both or neither)

environmentVariables.name: SEARXNG_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Optional basic auth password for SearXNG (set both or neither)

environmentVariables.name: YDC_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: You.com API key; enables You.com search (queries go to You.com, US)
